description: This file implements a consistency store for resource version tracking in Kubernetes, including interfaces, error types, and a real implementation with thread safety and resource version comparison logic.

classes.name: ConsistencyError
classes.description: Error type indicating resource version mismatch during consistency check.

classes.name: RealConsistencyStore
classes.description: Thread-safe implementation of the ConsistencyStore interface, managing resource version states.

classes.name: ownerRecord
classes.description: Internal structure to track resource versions per owner.

classes.name: NoopConsistencyStore
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the ConsistencyStore interface that always reports readiness.

methods.name: WroteAt
methods.description: Records the latest resource version written for an owner and resource.

methods.name: EnsureReady
methods.description: Checks if the recorded resource versions are up-to-date compared to store versions.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes the record for an owner if the ownerUID matches.

methods.name: getWrittenRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the resource version record for a specific owner.

methods.name: ensureWrittenRecord
methods.description: Ensures an owner record exists, creating or replacing as needed.

methods.name: NewConsistencyStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new thread-safe consistency store with given resource stores.

methods.name: WroteAt (ownerRecord)
methods.description: Updates the resource version for a specific resource, ensuring it is the newest.

methods.name: EnsureReady (ownerRecord)
methods.description: Verifies if the owner record's resource versions are synchronized with store versions.

methods.name: NewNoopConsistencyStore
methods.description: Creates a no-operation consistency store that always reports readiness.
